expo.name: Huddle
expo.//backgroundColor: Boardwalk's `colors.screen`, the token tv-stage.tsx paints. Stated here so the native window is already the right cream before any React view exists — otherwise a cold start flashes the platform default while the fonts resolve and TvLayout returns null. Kept honest by color-literals.test.ts, which is also why the value is written out: Expo transpiles app.config.ts and then requires it, so importing the token is not possible.
